name: Living Greater Cautery · Fire ×2
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.65-block radius for 21 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 4.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 10.8 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 5.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 15 s
• Growth: up to 15 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
